## About
We started as a small fleet repair company, and we've built the business on customer service. We're still locally owned and family operated to this day.
We know how much it matters to keep your equipment on the road. Our shop handles everything from quick lube to engine overhaul, our body shop does accident repair, painting and fabrication, and our sales and rental folks can set you up with a Mitsubishi Fuso.
Customers rate us 4.5 from 63 Google reviews. One reviewer called the place a "really mellow atmosphere" with "positive and helpful staff."

## Services
- New & Used Truck Sales: New and used Mitsubishi Fuso trucks with a variety of bodies and accessories to fit what you need. Call Ron or Patrick.
- Truck Rentals: Our truck rental department runs out of the main office with an all Mitsubishi Fuso rental fleet. Call Tom for your next rental truck.
- Diesel truck repair: A full service repair shop for all makes of diesel trucks.
- Body shop: Accident repair, painting, fabrication and more, with a 60 foot paint booth equipped to handle almost any piece of equipment. Give Johnny a call.
- AC repairs: Our shop handles AC repairs on your truck.
- Parts: A wide selection of truck parts, including Mitsubishi Fuso parts.
- 24/7 emergency road service: Broke down on the road? We offer 24/7 emergency road service.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer emergency road service?
A: Yes. We offer 24/7 emergency road service.

Q: Do you only work on Mitsubishi Fuso trucks?
A: No. Our shop repairs all makes of diesel trucks. One reviewer has brought us both Isuzu and Mitsubishi trucks.

Q: Can you work on trailers?
A: Yes. One customer told us our team got a problematic boat trailer beefed up and back on the road.

Q: How do I request service, a rental or a truck?
A: Fill out our request form with your truck's year, make, model and VIN, whether you need an estimate or a pick up, and when you need the work. We make every effort to respond within 24 hours.
